Hi Alex,

Thanks for trying Redwood's Quickstart guide. We saw developer intent on the docs CTA and wanted to offer a short technical walkthrough to show how to wire the SDK into your CI flow and optimize inference for dev environments.

If you'd like hands-on help, pick a 30-minute slot: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min-tech-demo?event=DS-4721

If you'd rather continue asynchronously, reply with your primary questions and we'll send targeted notes.

Cheers,
